units.source_text: 次日，源氏访问秋好皇后，和她谈了许多话。

en.t: The next day, Genji visited Empress Akikonomu and spoke with her at length.

units.source_text: 他对她说：“我现在闲居无事，应该常常来望望你。

en.t: He said to her, "Now that I am living quietly with little to do, I ought to come and see you often.

units.source_text: 并无特别事由，只是年纪大起来，常想把难于忘却的往事说些给你听听，并听你谈谈。

en.t: There is no special reason; only, as I grow older, I often wish to tell you something of the past that is hard to forget, and to hear you speak as well.

units.source_text: 但出门时，排场太大又不好，太简又不好，弄得左右为难，以致一向疏远了。

en.t: But when I go out, too much ceremony is unsuitable, and too little is unsuitable as well, so I am caught between the two and have long stayed away.

units.source_text: 比我年轻的人，有的先我而死了，有的先我而出家了，观此人世无常之相，不由人意气沮丧，难于安心。

en.t: People younger than I have died before me, and others have taken the tonsure before me; seeing the impermanence of this world, one cannot help losing heart and finding no peace.

units.source_text: 于是遁世出家之志，日渐坚强起来。

en.t: And so my wish to withdraw from the world and become a monk grows stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 但愿你照拂我的后人，免使他们孤苦无依。

en.t: I only hope that you will look after those I leave behind, so that they will not be lonely and without support.

units.source_text: 这话以前我屡次对你说过，务望牢记在心，勿负所托。”

en.t: I have said this to you many times before; please keep it firmly in mind and do not fail the trust I place in you."

units.source_text: 说时态度十分郑重。

en.t: As he spoke, his manner was deeply solemn.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后的模样总是很年轻，她答道：“让位之后，反比以前深居九重宫阙时难得见面，真乃意想不到之事，令人深感遗憾。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu always looked youthful, and she replied, "Since I gave up my position, it has become harder to meet than when I lived deep within the palace, which is truly unexpected and deeply regrettable.

units.source_text: 眼看诸人出家离俗，亦觉人世可厌。

en.t: Seeing so many people take vows and leave the secular world, I too feel weary of human life.

units.source_text: 但此心迄未向尊前禀明。

en.t: But I have not yet made this feeling known to you.

units.source_text: 此身万事皆蒙鼎力照拂，如今未得许可，心中不胜怅惘。”

en.t: In all things I have received your great care, and now, without your permission, my heart is filled with helpless sorrow."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“确实如此，昔年你深居宫中之时，虽然归宁日数有限，总得常常相见。

en.t: Genji said, "That is certainly true. In the old days, when you lived deep within the palace, although the days when you could return home were limited, we still managed to meet often.

units.source_text: 如今让位之后，反而没有借口，不能任意回家了。

en.t: Now that you have relinquished your position, there is instead no pretext, and you cannot return home whenever you wish.

units.source_text: 人世固然是无常的，然而没有特别痛苦的人，总难毅然决然地抛舍红尘。

en.t: The world is indeed impermanent, but people who have no particular suffering always find it hard to cast off worldly life with firm resolve.

units.source_text: 即使是心无挂碍、决意出家的人，亦自有种种牵累羁绊，你岂可模仿此等人行径而生学道之心？

en.t: Even those whose hearts are free of attachment and who have resolved to become monks still have all kinds of ties and obligations; how could you imitate such people and take up the wish to pursue the Way?

units.source_text: 你倘出家，反会使人不解而胡猜瞎说呢！

en.t: If you were to take vows, people would fail to understand and would instead make all sorts of wild guesses and gossip.

units.source_text: 此事决不可行！”

en.t: This absolutely must not be done!"

units.source_text: 秋好皇后但觉源氏尚未深知己心，不胜苦闷。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu only felt that Genji still did not truly understand her heart, and she was unbearably distressed.

units.source_text: 原来她很挂念亡母六条妃子死后受苦之状，不知她堕入了何等可怕的地狱业火之中。

en.t: In truth, she was deeply troubled by the suffering of her late mother, the Rokujo lady, after death, wondering into what terrible fires of hell she had fallen.

units.source_text: 她死后还要显灵作祟，自道姓名，被人嫌恶，源氏虽然竭力隐讳，但世人都爱讥评，自有人将此话传入秋好皇后耳中。

en.t: After death, her mother had appeared as a spirit and caused harm, even naming herself, and was hated for it; although Genji did all he could to conceal the matter, people love to criticize, and someone naturally carried the story to Empress Akikonomu's ears.

units.source_text: 她听到之后，悲痛不堪，便觉人世一切皆可厌弃。

en.t: After hearing it, she was overwhelmed with grief and came to feel that everything in the world was hateful and worth abandoning.

units.source_text: 她很想知道母亲鬼魂显灵说话的详情，但觉不便直说，只是迂回地言道：“前曾隐约传闻：先母死在阴司，罪孽十分深重。

en.t: She very much wanted to know the details of what her mother's ghost had said when it appeared, but feeling it improper to ask directly, she spoke indirectly: "I once heard a vague rumor that my late mother, in the realm of the dead, bore very grave sins.

units.source_text: 虽无明确证据，仿佛亦可推量。

en.t: Although there is no clear proof, it seems possible to infer as much.

units.source_text: 但为女儿的，只觉难忘死别之悲，不曾想到后世之事。

en.t: But as her daughter, I only felt the unforgettable sorrow of parting in death and never thought about the world to come.

units.source_text: 愿得深通佛道之人，善为开示，俾得皈依三宝，亲自拯救亡母于业火焰中。

en.t: I wish to find someone deeply versed in the Buddhist path who can guide me well, so that I may take refuge in the Three Treasures and personally rescue my late mother from the flames of karmic fire.

units.source_text: 年龄越长，这愿望越是恳切了。”

en.t: The older I grow, the more earnest this wish becomes."

units.source_text: 源氏觉得她这愿望实甚有理，深为同情，答道：“地狱业火，谁也难于避免。

en.t: Genji felt that her wish was truly reasonable and was deeply sympathetic, so he replied, "The karmic fires of hell are difficult for anyone to avoid.

units.source_text: 俗人虽知此理，但在朝露一般短促的生涯中，总难抛舍红尘。

en.t: Although ordinary people know this truth, in a life as brief as morning dew, it is always hard for them to cast off the world.

units.source_text: 目连是一位近于成佛的圣僧，故能即时将母救出。

en.t: Maudgalyayana was a holy monk close to buddhahood, and therefore he could rescue his mother at once.

units.source_text: 但谁能继承此例呢？

en.t: But who can follow such an example?

units.source_text: 即使你卸却钗环，恐于此世犹有遗恨吧！

en.t: Even if you were to remove your hairpins and ornaments, you would likely still have regrets in this world.

units.source_text: 你虽不出家，亦可坚守此志，逐渐举办种种法事，超度亡母脱离苦海。

en.t: Even without taking vows, you can hold firmly to this resolve, gradually perform various Buddhist rites, and help your late mother escape the sea of suffering.

units.source_text: 我也有志出家，然而人事纷烦，辞官闲居，也属枉然，只是蹉跎岁月。

en.t: I too have the wish to become a monk, but worldly affairs are tangled and troublesome; even resigning office and living quietly has proved futile, and I merely let the years slip by.

units.source_text: 若得成遂出家之愿，我必静居修身，帮你为你亡母祈求冥福，可惜全是妄想。”

en.t: If my wish to take vows could be fulfilled, I would surely live quietly and discipline myself, helping you pray for blessings in the next world for your late mother; unfortunately, it is all a vain dream."

units.source_text: 二人共叹世事尽属虚空，都可厌弃抛舍，然而毕竟难于痛下决心。

en.t: The two of them lamented together that all worldly affairs were empty and could be hated and cast aside, yet in the end it was difficult to make a firm decision.
